ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: pairwise_sigmoid_advantage_loss_mean_agg
ir.intuition: Compute the pairwise sigmoid advantage loss and aggregate losses by mean to stabilize training dynamics by giving equal weight to each pair regardless of weight sum magnitude.
ir.pseudocode:
margin = lpw - lpl - beta * advantage_gap
scaled_margin = alpha * margin
losses = -log(sigmoid(scaled_margin))
weighted_losses = weight * losses
loss = mean(weighted_losses)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    adv = batch['advantage_gap']
    weight = batch.get('weight', None)
    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))
    beta = float(extra.get('beta', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('beta', 0.5)))
    margin = ops.sub(ops.sub(lpw, lpl), ops.mul(beta, adv))
    scaled_margin = ops.mul(alpha, margin)
    losses = ops.neg(ops.logsigmoid(scaled_margin))
    if weight is None:
        weight = ops.ones_like(losses)
    weighted_losses = ops.mul(weight, losses)
    loss = ops.mean(weighted_losses)
    return loss
